SELECT m.code, m.name, m.spec, m.unit_price, m.stock_qty, m.client_code AS supplier, (SELECT wh.warehouse_nm FROM tb_warehouse wh WHERE wh.warehouse_cd = m.warehouse_cd LIMIT 1) AS warehouse, m.safety_stock, m.base_order_qty, m.allergens, m.sub_category, (SELECT split_part(i.item_nm, ' — ', 1) FROM tb_common_code_item i JOIN tb_common_code_group g ON g.common_code_group_id = i.group_id AND g.group_code = 'SUB_MATERIAL_CATEGORY' JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND t.tenant_code = 'SONGYEON' WHERE i.item_code = sub_category LIMIT 1) AS sub_category_nm, m.unit, (SELECT i.item_nm FROM tb_common_code_item i JOIN tb_common_code_group g ON g.common_code_group_id = i.group_id AND g.group_code = 'UNIT' JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND t.tenant_code = 'SONGYEON' WHERE i.item_code = unit LIMIT 1) AS unit_nm,
COALESCE((SELECT e.name FROM employees e WHERE e.id = m.reg_user_id), m.reg_user_id) AS reg_user_nm, TO_CHAR(m.reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS reg_dt, COALESCE((SELECT e.name FROM employees e WHERE e.id = m.upd_user_id), m.upd_user_id) AS upd_user_nm, TO_CHAR(m.upd_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS upd_dt, m.use_yn, m.unit_weight, m.box_qty, (SELECT MAX(SUBSTRING(u.created_at, 1, 10)) FROM production_material_usage u WHERE u.material_code = m.code) AS last_used_date, sp.supplier_name, sp.supplier_codes, sp.supplier_names FROM materials m
LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT string_agg(COALESCE(c.name, '삭제된 업체(' || e.code || ')'), ', ' ORDER BY e.ord) AS supplier_name, array_agg(e.code ORDER BY e.ord) AS supplier_codes, array_agg(COALESCE(c.name, '삭제된 업체(' || e.code || ')') ORDER BY e.ord) AS supplier_names FROM jsonb_array_elements_text( CASE WHEN replace(COALESCE(m.client_code, ''), ' ', '') ~ '^[[]("[0-9]+"(,"[0-9]+")*)?[]]$' THEN m.client_code::jsonb ELSE '[]'::jsonb END ) WITH ORDINALITY AS e(code, ord) LEFT JOIN clients c ON c.client_code = e.code ) sp ON TRUE
WHERE m.name LIKE '%' || #{_parameter} || '%' OR m.code LIKE '%' || #{_parameter} || '%'
ORDER BY m.code

SELECT id AS "clientId", client_code AS "clientCode", name AS "clientName" FROM clients WHERE client_type IN ( SELECT i.item_code FROM tb_common_code_item i JOIN tb_common_code_group g ON g.common_code_group_id = i.group_id AND g.group_code = 'CUSTOMER_CATEGORY' JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND t.tenant_code = 'SONGYEON' WHERE i.item_nm LIKE '%매입%' ) AND COALESCE(use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y' AND name IS NOT NULL AND client_code IS NOT NULL ORDER BY name
SELECT name FROM clients WHERE client_code = #{clientCode} LIMIT 1

SELECT i.item_code FROM tb_common_code_item i JOIN tb_common_code_group g ON g.common_code_group_id = i.group_id AND g.group_code = 'SUB_MATERIAL_CATEGORY' JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND t.tenant_code = 'SONGYEON' WHERE COALESCE(i.use_at, 'Y') = 'Y' AND COALESCE(g.use_at, 'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY i.sort_order, i.item_code

SELECT i.item_code FROM tb_common_code_item i JOIN tb_common_code_group g ON g.common_code_group_id = i.group_id AND g.group_code = 'UNIT' JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND t.tenant_code = 'SONGYEON' WHERE COALESCE(i.use_at, 'Y') = 'Y' AND COALESCE(g.use_at, 'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY i.sort_order, i.item_code

SELECT code, name, unit_price, sub_category, (SELECT split_part(i.item_nm, ' — ', 1) FROM tb_common_code_item i JOIN tb_common_code_group g ON g.common_code_group_id = i.group_id AND g.group_code = 'SUB_MATERIAL_CATEGORY' JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND t.tenant_code = 'SONGYEON' WHERE i.item_code = sub_category LIMIT 1) AS sub_category_nm, client_code AS supplier, spec FROM materials WHERE code = #{code}

SELECT CASE WHEN LENGTH(t.next_code) < 6 THEN LPAD(t.next_code, 6, '0') ELSE t.next_code END FROM ( SELECT CAST(COALESCE(MAX(CAST(code AS NUMERIC)), 0) + 1 AS VARCHAR) AS next_code FROM materials WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(code, '^[0-9]+$') ) t
INSERT INTO materials ( code, name, spec, unit_price, reg_user_id, reg_dt ) VALUES ( #{code}, #{name}, #{spec}, #{unitPrice,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{regUserId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recipe_version_bom WHERE material_code IS NULL AND material_name = #{name}

SELECT p.code AS "productCode", p.name AS "productName", p.spec AS "productSpec", b.ratio_percent AS "ratioPercent" FROM bom b JOIN products p ON p.code = b.product_code WHERE b.material_code = #{code} ORDER BY b.ratio_percent DESC

AND product_code IN #{productCode}
UPDATE materials SET use_yn = #{useYn}, upd_user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, upd_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE code = #{code}
UPDATE materials SET upd_user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, upd_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE code = #{code}

UPDATE bom SET unit_price_per_kg = #{unitPrice,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, amount_per_kg = CASE WHEN ratio_percent IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ratio_percent * #{unitPrice,jdbcType=DOUBLE} END WHERE material_code = #{code}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO material_price_log ( material_code, material_name, changed_at, old_price, new_price ) VALUES ( #{code}, #{name}, #{changedAt}, #{oldPrice,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{newPrice,jdbcType=DOUBLE} )
mapper.select: SELECT changed_at AS "changedAt", old_price AS "oldPrice", new_price AS "newPrice" FROM material_price_log WHERE material_code = #{code} ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO material_price_schedule ( material_code, material_name, new_price, effective_date, applied, created_at ) VALUES ( #{code}, #{name}, #{newPrice,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{effectiveDate}, 0, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, new_price AS "newPrice", effective_date AS "effectiveDate", applied FROM material_price_schedule WHERE material_code = #{code} ORDER BY effective_date

SELECT id, material_code AS "materialCode", material_name AS "materialName", new_price AS "newPrice" FROM material_price_schedule WHERE applied = 0 AND effective_date <= #{today} ORDER BY effective_date, id
